records.text: An anonymous source told Owens that Tyler Robinson was pressured to come in and was told he had no other option or authorities would break down his door
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #10 (Ep ChuWo-n49B8)

appearances.snippet: I had a source and it was solid that actually he was pressured into coming in and told that he had no other option or they were going to bang down his door.

verification.notes: The claim depends on an unnamed source. Public reporting confirms Robinson feared being shot by police or facing a SWAT response and ultimately surrendered peacefully, but it does not establish that authorities pressured him with a no-choice ultimatum. The anonymous-source account cannot be independently authenticated.
